items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: That's when Fletcher had that tremendous band at the Roseland. Willie (Inaudible) Smith -- all the top men in there, you know. His wife called me to come down.

ctx.x: Fifty-five, yes. And here you had (inaudible) one of the top bands in the country, you know, the beginning, you know, like -- I guess Fletcher wasn't paying too much more money at the Roseland. Maybe seventy, a hundred, maybe a hundred -- the guys making (inaudible) or something like that. But that was like -- But you remember, the living conditions was down to nothing.
